title: LSP integration lacks an exact debug source-binding contract

minimal_reproducer.observation: only a heuristic function declaration location is available

expected_semantics: The language service should resolve a source URI/span/symbol to a stable semantic operation or event identity using compiler-owned source maps.
actual_behavior_limitation: The current service/reference artifacts do not expose a debugger location protocol, and operation source spans are absent from the runtime result. The local adapter's path/line scan is explicitly heuristic and unsuitable for breakpoint binding.
why_capability_matters: Editor debugging must bind user-visible source constructs to the same identities used by execution, trace, and provenance queries.
current_workaround: Provide integration/lsp-contract.json and leave operation source null; expose exact source/program digest and function identity only.

host_language_code_required.why: The missing binding is not hidden by host code; it is recorded as unavailable.

proposed_primitive_or_semantic_direction: Standardize source identity, URI/path normalization, coordinate encoding, symbol identity, span, compiler phase, and exact/derived/unavailable binding status across compiler and LSP.
resolution_criteria: The LSP can resolve a source span to an exact semantic identity and `mncs-debug` can return that same binding in trace/inspection output.

campaign_review.disposition: Shared source/module/function/test/span vocabulary is explicit; language-service runtime-operation binding and breakpoint resolution remain unverified.
campaign_review.workaround: Project exact declaration spans and show derived/unavailable binding status.
